title: Flulies!
description: this mod adds a brand new mob FLULIE!. VERY CUTE OMG
body:
### This is a mod which adds a brand new mob... FLULIE!

Flulie has 8 colors:

gray, black, gold, green, red, blue, orange and white

they appear in a special biome FLOWER PLAINS

they drop tail which gives you special effects like speed and jump boost when you click RMB:

**THIS MOD HAS SUPPORT FOR POLISH AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE (yay)**
